name: metavr_software_paths
description: Report the on-disk paths of developer software detected on this machine: Meta tools installed via `metavr tools`, the Android SDK (standard locations and any copy bundled inside a Unity editor), Java (JDK/JRE), and installed Unity editors. Returns a human-readable manifest. Read-only — it does not install anything; to install or repair software, tell the user to run `metavr init` (guided setup) or `metavr tools install <name>`.
